paite: Huan Shittim a Israelte ataam sung un, pasalte'n Moab numeite akithuahpih uhi.
heading: Peor Ah Israel Mite
english: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;

paite: Apathiante uh ma a kithoihnate ah achial ua; huchi in ane ua, apathiante ma ah akun uhi.
english: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.

paite: Israelte'n Peor Baal abe samta uhi. Huchi in Israelte tung ah TOUPA hehna akuangta hi.
english: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Mipite heutu tengteng pi inla, TOUPA hehna lauhuaitak mai Israelte tung a pan akikhinmang theihna ding in sun khovak ah amaute that in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to Yahweh before the sun, that the fierce anger of Yahweh may turn away from Israel.”

paite: Mosi in Israelte vaihawmte kiang ah, "Peor Baal biakna a tel peuhmahte that vek un," achi hi.
english: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”

paite: Ngai in, puanin kongkhak a mite kap a a-om laitak un, Mosi leh Israel omkhawmte mitmuh in Israel mi khat in Midian numei khat a-unaute kiang ah ahon pi hi.
english: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar tapa Phinehas in amuhtak in omkhawmte a pan athou a, teipi khat alata hi.
english: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.

paite: Israel mi apuanin sung ah adelhlut a, Israel mi toh anih un asun pailet a, numei pen agil ah asun pailet hi. Huchi in Israel suante tung a hipi adaita hi.
english: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stopped among the children of Israel.

paite: Himahleh huai hipi a site singnih-le-sangli ahi uh.
english: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.

paite: "Siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar tapa Phinehas in alak ua kei a dia phatuam angaih ziak in Israel suante a pan ka hehna aheimang a, huchi in ka thikthusiat ziak in Israel suante ka hihmangthang kei hi.
english: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.

paite: Huaiziak in ngai in, ka lemna thukhun amah ka pe ding hi.
english: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.

paite: Amah leh anung a asuante a ding in tangtawn siamputna thukhun ahi dia; a Pathian a dia phatuam ngai a Israel suante a dia kilemna abawlsak ziak in, chi in gen in," achi hi.
english: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”

paite: Midian numei toh athah uh Israel mi min Jimri ahi a, amah Simeonte lak a inkuan a vaihawm makai Salu tapa ahi.
english: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.

paite: Athah uh Midian numei min Kozbi ahi. Amah Zur tanu ahi a, Midiante inkuan lak a heutu ahi.
english: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.

paite: Amau Peor tungtang thu leh a-unaunu uh Midiante heutu tanu Kozbi toh kisai a noute ahon khem lai un, melma bang a hon sai uh ahi. Peor ziak a hipi ahong tun in Kozbi thah a om ahi,” achi hi.
english: for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident regarding Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”
